caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench or daybed with curved, scrolled armrests on each end, made from a light brown wood. The legs and arms are constructed from continuous pieces of wood with elegant, smooth curves, creating a symmetrical form. The seating area features a cushion with a light blue background and a floral pattern consisting of green leaves, yellow details, and some other subtle colors. The entire object is centrally placed on a plain, off-white or light beige background with no other items or scenery, and a small signature “P.L. Vinott.” is visible below the right side of the seat.
title: Day Bed
